cues.en: The first step is to normalize each embeddings vector such that it has a norm of one.
cues.zh: 第一步，將每個嵌入向量正規化，使範數為 1。

cues.en: Now you don't need a for loop to do this step either.

cues.en: You can do it with division and broadcasting in numpy.

cues.en: Now, one important thing to note here make a copy of the embeddings matrix.

cues.en: You don't want to change the original matrix values.
cues.zh: 不想改變原始矩陣值，

cues.en: You want to make a copy of the embeddings matrix that has unit normed embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 要建立另一份，各嵌入向量範數為 1 的矩陣。

cues.en: And why do you want to do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, remember that the formula for the cosine similarity is the dot product between two vectors divided by the product of their norms.
cues.zh: 記得，餘弦相似度，是兩向量內積，除以範數乘積。

cues.en: So if we scale all the vectors in the matrix such that their norms are already one, then we can actually
cues.zh: 如果先縮放矩陣中的所有向量，使範數都為 1，

cues.en: just ignore the denominator term completely, because the square root of one times the square root of one is still one.
cues.zh: 就能完全忽略分母，因為 1 的平方根乘以 1 的平方根，仍然是 1。

cues.en: So just make sure that you are calculating the norm along the correct dimension.
cues.zh: 但要確認，沿正確維度計算範數。

cues.en: You want to normalize each embedding vector for each token, not all the dimensions across the tokens.
cues.zh: 要正規化每個 token 的嵌入向量，而不是跨所有 token，正規化某個維度。

cues.en: Anyway, once you have normalized the vectors in the matrix, cosine similarity is really simple.
